leverage.exposure: No leveraged position is open right now, and one is planned rather than accidental. The balance is positive but thin, and the standing offer commits effectively all of it plus a large borrow. If the offer wins, the balance goes deeply negative and must be cleared by the single sale a twelve-man squad permits. There is a great deal of slack — the matchday lock is almost six days away — so this is comfortable rather than urgent, but the sale must not be forgotten, because a negative balance at matchday start scores zero for the entire matchday. The one thing that could turn this from planned into accidental is the price moving above the ceiling tonight and the offer being left standing anyway: that is why the instruction is to pull it rather than let it ride.

binding_gap: The binding gap is the weak fourth defender, and the fix is already bid for. Rohr replaces him in the fielded eleven and the improvement survives the unwind sale that has to follow. No other position is short: the goalkeeper slot is filled, the midfield and attack both field their full complement, and adding a body anywhere else would displace someone who scores more. What binds harder than the gap itself is money — the squad is fully invested, so the board is closed regardless of merit until the Rohr sequence resolves one way or the other.

verdict.headline: One live action and it turns on a clock, not on judgement.
verdict.headline_short: One live action and it turns on a clock, not on judgement.
verdict.detail: One live action and it turns on a clock, not on judgement. Georg's standing offer for Maximilian Rohr resolves overnight, and the daily market-value update fires first at 20:00Z. Rohr posted a very large away score in MD2 and his price is rising, so the listing ask is likely to climb past the offer within the hour. Re-read the market just after 20:05Z and do one of three things: leave the offer alone if the ask still sits under it; raise to the affordability ceiling if the ask has moved above it but the ceiling still covers it; pull the offer if the ask has cleared the ceiling, rather than leave money committed to a bid that cannot win. The trade itself is excellent and the constraint is purely money — after the unwind sale the fielded eleven improves materially for a very small net cash outlay, an order of magnitude better than anything else on the board. Nothing else is actionable: the squad is fully invested, every other listing fails on affordability, on marginal points, or on both.

sell.reason: No sale should be made tonight on its own merits. The only sale in play is the unwind that follows a successful Rohr purchase, and which of the two candidates to use should be decided after the market-value update rather than now, because the two legs move in opposite directions at the tick: the midfield leg is falling and the attacking leg is rising. Take whichever is worth more once the new values are published — the difference in fielded points between the two resulting shapes is three points, which is not worth defending against a cash gap of roughly a million. The perennial candidate at the back stays put: at eleven players selling him costs the penalty, and he is too cheap to unwind the leverage in any case.

standing.name: Sambi Lokonga
standing.why: THE UNWIND LEG OF BUY Bsmq4uu - CONDITIONAL, AND THE CONDITION IS NOT OPTIONAL. Sell him ONLY once Rohr has actually landed (check get_squad, per H5om1wi do not trust the calibration table's [executed] flag). At 11 players a sale is a -100 penalty; at 12 it is free. If the Rohr auction is lost, CLOSE THIS CALL AND KEEP HIM - this supersedes nothing about his standing block, which already says exactly that. WHY HIM AND NOT CONTE, the only other candidate: on points they are a coin flip (Lokonga ap 44 v Conte ap 47, so Conte is fractionally better and the Lokonga route is worth +3 fielded points because it keeps Widmer 29 in a 5-2-3 rather than dropping Conte 47 from a 5-3-2 - 1283 v 1280). The tiebreak is the money. Lokonga is BLEEDING: mvt 2, sdmvt -1.125.317, i.e. roughly -1,1M a day, and he is the worst points-per-euro in the squad at 9.731.816 / 44 = 221k per point. Conte is RISING hard: mvt 1, sdmvt +1.284.273, tfhmvt +93.437. Sell the decaying asset and keep the appreciating one. SELECTION CUTS THE OTHER WAY AND IS DELIBERATELY OVERRIDDEN: Lokonga is a confirmed HSV starter (no news dated 04.09.2026 or later; note the hsv.de "Verletzungsupdate zu Sambi Lokonga" ankle-ligament story is 09.02.2026 = LAST SEASON and was correctly discarded again this run), while Conte was BENCHED by Hoffenheim v Dortmund on 05.09.2026 (sport.de liveticker; rotated for Lemperle and Rots). That argues for selling Conte instead. It is outweighed by the mv trajectories: Conte benched but appreciating is still the better asset to hold, and a start is not points. FORMATION DEPENDENCY, THE ONE THING THAT COULD FORCE THE SWITCH: this route leaves 1GK/5DEF/2MID/3ATT and needs 5-2-3 to be selectable. If the app does not offer 5-2-3, sell CONTE instead (9.292.405, leaves 1/5/3/2 = 5-3-2, definitely legal, 1280 fielded, and the bid was sized so that route also stays positive at +45.172). Verify the shape in-app before clicking; do not discover it after the sale. Instant-sale to Kickbase pays exactly mv, measured 8 for 8.

standing.name: Amoako
standing.why: THE UNWIND. This is the pre-priced second leg of the Conte trade and it is now due. Conte (3204) settled to Georg Kitz 2026-09-05T12:52:14Z at 12.000.000 against mv 9.292.405 = +29,14%, exactly the Brncinm call, and the balance is now -566.376. Selling Amoako to Kickbase at mv 1.569.143 puts it at +1.002.767 and closes the leveraged position outright. REVERSES AND CLOSES Hjmhal7, WHICH SAID DO NOT SELL HIM - say that out loud to Georg. Hjmhal7 was right on its own premise and the premise is dead: it protected Amoako as the ELEVENTH BODY of an 11-man squad, where selling him meant 10 players and the -100 penalty. Conte makes the squad TWELVE, so Amoako is now the twelfth body and the sale is free. POINTS COST ZERO, MEASURED: Amoako has no ap field at all (0 points, 0 minutes, 0 apps, 2x unused sub per Ligainsider 05.09.2026), so he leaves the fielded eleven at 12 players anyway. Squad after the sale is 11 = 1GK/4DEF/3MID/3ATT, which IS 4-3-3 exactly, legal, fully placed, fielded points 1439. HE IS THE RIGHT BODY AND THE ALTERNATIVE IS MEASURED: selling Widmer instead (mv 1.852.587, +283.444 more cash) forces 3-4-3 and costs 29 fielded points; selling Lokonga (mv 9.731.816) forces Amoako back into the eleven and costs 44. Amoako is the only points-free sale on the books. TIMING - SELL BEFORE 20:00Z: market values tick at 2026-09-05T20:00:00Z (mvud, first-party) and Amoako is decaying hard - tfhmvt -49.393, sdmvt -811.827 - so every tick he is held costs ~50k of unwind. There is no matchday risk forcing the hand (MD3 locks 2026-09-11T18:30Z, ~149,6h away, and MD2's lock passed 04.09 18:30Z with the balance still at +11.433.624, so no scored matchday has ever seen the negative), but there is no reason on earth to wait either. AFTER THIS THE SQUAD IS AT 11 AND FULLY INVESTED: cash ~1,00M, zero further sales possible without triggering -100, so the usable buy ceiling is ~1,00M and nothing on the board is reachable. That is the correct state, not a problem to solve.

buy.reason: Rohr is the buy and he is the only buy. Verified this run on dated sources: he started at centre-back and played the full match in Elversberg's away win on 5 September, was not substituted, and no injury was reported; the club's injury and suspension entries name only two other players, and he is absent from the league-wide injury table. He is now a start in every league match this season. The case rests on the net trade, not the headline price — the eleven improves by a meaningful margin for a net cash outlay far smaller than the ask, because the unwind sale returns most of the money. Because a Kickbase board listing is highest-bid-wins rather than seller's choice, raising genuinely buys win probability here, and the listing sits several hours out — the exact configuration in which the Makengo bid was held too low and lost. Everything else on the board is logged and rejected: the new Dortmund midfield ask fails on both affordability and marginal points and is priced well above the honest manager-ask band; Kimmich has been bought off the board and immediately relisted by a rival at a whisker over value, and remains unaffordable with a now-regressed average; and the new arrivals with no scoring record or negative averages join the standing zero-average class, one of them suspended.

standing.name: Maximilian Rohr
standing.why: CONDITIONAL ON THE 2026-09-05T20:00:00Z MARKET-VALUE TICK, WHICH IS 1h13m AWAY AND WILL VERY LIKELY PUT THE LIVE 10.250.000 OFFER UNDERWATER. This does not revise BUY Bsmq4uu (still open, still correct at the current ask); it is the contingency that Bsmq4uu itself asked the next run to price. STATE OF THE OFFER AT 18:45Z: listing prc 9.726.134 = exactly mv, ofc 1 with Georg alone in ofs at 10.250.000 = +5,39%, exs 22363 resolving ~2026-09-06T01:07Z. WHY THE TICK IS THE PROBLEM: Rohr posted ~115 points in MD2 (p 87 -> 202, ap 101) and mvt reads 1 (rising). Every Kickbase listing observed in this ledger carries prc == mv exactly, so the ask moves with the tick. The measured magnitude of a big-matchday tick, taken from this run's own squad sdmvt figures, is +9% to +34%: ter Horst scored 143 and moved +2.244.127 on 8.797.749 = +25,5%; Onyeka scored 139 and moved +2.024.477 on 9.286.468 = +21,8%; Conte scored 106 and moved +1.284.273 on 9.292.405 = +13,8%; Gregoritsch 195 -> +11,8%; Minjae 110 -> +11,8%; Matsima 138 -> +9,0%. Rohr at ~115 sits squarely in that band, so a post-tick mv of roughly 10,7M to 12,2M is the central expectation and +5,39% of headroom does not cover it. THE DECISION RULE, so the 20:45Z run does not re-derive it: re-read list_market at 20:05Z. (a) If the new prc is at or under 10.250.000, do nothing - the standing offer still clears. (b) If the new prc is above 10.250.000 but the affordability ceiling still covers it, RAISE to the ceiling. (c) If the new prc exceeds the ceiling, the buy is DEAD on affordability and the offer should be pulled rather than left to fail. THE CEILING MUST BE RECOMPUTED AT 20:05Z, NOT REUSED FROM HERE - this is the trap in this call. It is cash 1.002.767 plus the single sale a post-buy squad of 12 permits, and BOTH unwind legs move at the same tick in OPPOSITE directions. Lokonga is mvt 2 FALLING with sdmvt -1.125.317 and scored only 44, so his 9.731.816 will probably shrink; Conte is mvt 1 RISING with sdmvt +1.284.273 and scored 106, so his 9.292.405 will probably grow. Take the LARGER of the two post-tick values: selling Lokonga leaves 1/5/2/3 = 5-2-3 fielding 1283, selling Conte leaves 1/5/3/2 = 5-3-2 fielding 1280, a three-point difference that is not worth defending against a cash difference of a million. 10.734.583 recorded here is the PRE-TICK Lokonga-route ceiling and is a placeholder for that computation. WHY RAISING IS RIGHT RATHER THAN MERELY TOLERABLE, WHICH THE HEADLINE PRICE HIDES: the purchase is not P for 101 points, it is (P minus the unwind proceeds) for the NET points gain. Post-buy-and-unwind the eleven goes 1226 -> 1283, i.e. +57 fielded points, for a net cash outlay of P - 9.731.816. At the current 10.250.000 that is 518.184 for +57 = 9,1k per marginal point; even at the full 10.734.583 ceiling it is 1.002.767 for +57 = 17,6k per marginal point. Set that against the bar this ledger has been applying to everything else on the board - Conte 107k, Kosugi 351k rejected, Demirovic 465k, Robin Koch 184k gross - and Rohr is an order of magnitude better than anything else available. So the ceiling is a hard money constraint and NOT a judgement that the extra premium is unattractive: pay it if it fits. AND PER H5om1wi, RAISING ON A KICKBASE LISTING BUYS WIN PROBABILITY, because these are highest-bid-wins rather than seller's choice - this is the exact configuration in which the Makengo bid was held at +13,03% and lost to +60,76%. ofc 1 now is a snapshot, not a forecast, and the listing sits six hours out, which is the late-contest window that doctrine describes. NEWS VERIFIED THIS RUN, ALL DATED 05.09.2026: he started at CB and played the full 90 in Elversberg's 4:3 win at Gladbach (news.de match report, 05.09.2026, no substitution and no injury noted); Ligainsider's Elversberg page has him in the XI and Elversberg's Verletzte-und-Gesperrte entries are only Seifert and Zimmerschied; he is absent from Ligainsider's league-wide injury table read this run. st 0. He is now 3/3 starts. Fitness and selection are not in question - only the price is.

standing.name: Maximilian Rohr
standing.why: REVERSES AVOID Abhbatn, WHICH WAS WRONG ON ITS ARITHMETIC, NOT ON ITS FACTS. Abhbatn (and A06b88u before it) rejected every DEF on the ground that "a DEF unwinds only against Widmer, ceiling 2.855.354". THAT IS FALSE AND IT HAS BEEN SILENTLY KILLING EVERY DEFENDER ON THE BOARD FOR SEVERAL RUNS. Buying a DEF takes the squad to 12 = 1GK/5DEF/3MID/3ATT, and the unwind does NOT have to be a defender - selling a MID leaves 1/5/2/3 (5-2-3) and selling an ATT leaves 1/5/3/2 (5-3-2), both legal shapes. The true post-buy unwind ceiling is therefore cash 1.002.767 + Lokonga 9.731.816 = 10.734.583, or + Conte 9.292.405 = 10.295.172 on the formation-safe route - not 2.855.354. Rohr at mv 9.726.134 fits inside BOTH. THE SECOND DATA POINT Hyu2vg2 ASKED FOR HAS NOW LANDED: he reads p 202 / ap 101 (was ap 87 off one match), i.e. ~115 points in MD2. NEWS VERIFIED THIS RUN, all dated: Yahoo Sports and Eurosport confirmed lineups 05.09.2026 start him at CB away at Gladbach (Elversberg won 4:3 from two down - ZDFheute, sportschau, sport.de liveticker, all 05.09.2026); fussballdaten.de 26/27 gives him 2/2 starts, 100% start rate, 95,6% of available minutes; ligainsider 31.08.2026 "Rohr nur erschoepft: Keine Verletzung bei Auswechslung" explicitly clears the MD1 substitution as exhaustion not injury; he is absent from Elversberg's ligainsider Verletzte-und-Gesperrte table (05.09), which lists only Seifert and Zimmerschied; contract extended to summer 2028 (sv07elversberg.de), so no exit risk. st 0. THE POINTS CASE: ap 101 at 9.726.134 = 96,3k per fielded point, better than every outfielder Georg owns except Gregoritsch 61,4k, ter Horst 95,6k and Onyeka 86,0k, and far better than the man he funds himself by replacing. Fielded eleven goes 1226 -> 1283 on the Lokonga unwind (+57) or 1280 on the Conte unwind (+54). PRICE AND SEQUENCING: bid 10.250.000 = +5,39% over mv, deliberately set so that EITHER unwind route still leaves a positive balance (Lokonga +484.583, Conte +45.172). BID FIRST, SELL AFTER - do not sell to raise the cash, because a lost auction would leave the squad at 10. The offer opens a leveraged position of about -9,25M which is unwound the moment he lands; MD3 does not lock until 2026-09-11T18:30Z, 145h away, so there is ample slack, but the sale must not be forgotten. LATE-CONTEST RISK PER H5om1wi: ofc 0 now but the listing resolves ~00:57Z, roughly eight hours out, which is exactly the Makengo window - rivals arrive after the last run that looks at it. 10.250.000 is the affordability ceiling, not a judgement that +5,39% is enough; it is the most that can be bid without stranding a negative balance. CAUTION FOR THE NEXT RUN: market values tick at 2026-09-05T20:00Z and Rohr just posted ~115 away points with mvt 1, so his mv and therefore prc will probably RISE tonight - re-check that the offer still clears the listing price after the tick and re-price against the new ceiling.

killed_this_run.name: Joshua Kimmich (David relist)
killed_this_run.why: SUCCESSOR TO THE NOW-CLOSED Aioamqx, WHICH RESOLVED EXACTLY AS WRITTEN. David bought him off the Kickbase board at 2026-09-05T18:12:30Z for 59.877.200 against mv 59.871.080 = +0,01%, i.e. an uncontested Kickbase listing clearing at mv for the fourteenth measured time, and RELISTED him as a manager ask 179 seconds later at 18:15:29Z for 59.900.000 = +0,05% over mv. Georg never bid and the AVOID cost nothing. THE NEW LISTING CHANGES THE INSTRUMENT AND NOTHING ELSE. Two of Aioamqx's three grounds are untouched and one has strengthened. (a) AFFORDABILITY, now absolute: the balance is 1.002.767 with 10.250.000 already committed to the live Rohr offer, against an ask of 59,9M. There is no combination of sales that reaches it without gutting the fielded eleven, and this is the standing rule Arcck9h recorded - Georg is fully invested and the board is closed to the big names regardless of merit. (b) POINTS PER EURO: his ap has REGRESSED from 303 to 278 now that MD2 is in the mean (p 556 over two appearances), which is precisely the regression Hp0rkuf predicted and Aioamqx anticipated. 59.900.000 / 278 = 215k per fielded point, WORSE than the 198k that was already the second-worst efficiency in the squad. The one thing that improved - he is now a genuine two-match 278, not a one-match 303 - improves the confidence in the number, not the number. (c) The timing objection in Aioamqx is spent: Bayern's MD2 at Schalke has been played, so a future purchase could in principle score in MD3. That is the only ground that has lapsed and it was the weakest of the three. NOTE THE PATTERN FOR ITS OWN SAKE, because it is worth more than the player: David is doing what PhiL95 did with Itakura and Volte_28 did with his three-listing dump - buying at mv off the board and immediately reselling above mv to the league. At +0,05% this is the most honestly priced of those relists and still leaves no margin for a buyer. REVERSAL: unchanged from Aioamqx and it is not close - his mv must fall under roughly 120k per point (about 33M at ap 278) AND Georg must be holding idle cash with no better claim. Being Joshua Kimmich is not a reversal condition.

That is worse than Kosugi's 351k (Adr2dyh) and Demirovic's 465k (Au23b15), both already rejected on exactly this test, and roughly forty times worse than the Rohr trade now on the table. (3) HIGH-CLUSTER PRICING ON A SELLER'S-CHOICE INSTRUMENT: +12,49% sits far above the measured manager-ask low cluster of +0,50% to +6,47% (H8t606f(A)), and per Hlovt4t a high bid on a manager ask does not even guarantee the player. This is the same overpricing PhiL95 tried with Itakura +15,58% - and Itakura went UNSOLD and was dumped back to Kickbase at exactly mv 12.112.833 at 15:23:34Z today, which is the market's verdict on the tactic. Not news-checked: he failed on first-party arithmetic three times over before a sweep was warranted. REVERSAL: only if the ask falls under roughly 4,7M, i.e. near 110k per MARGINAL point over whoever he would actually displace recomputed at that time, AND Georg has cash with no better claim on it, AND a dated Dortmund XI starts him. A further trim to Daggi D.'s ask is NOT a reversal - the gap to close is about 27M, not 3M.
